T="$TMPDIR"; while IFS=$'\t' read -r f cb; do
  def=$(grep -n "^\(static \)\?\(void \|[a-zA-Z_]* \)\?$cb(" $f 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  [ -z "$def" ] && def=$(grep -n "$cb(struct\|$cb(unsigned" $f 2>/dev/null | grep -v tasklet_init | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  [ -z "$def" ] && continue
  end=$((def+80))
  body=$(sed -n "${def},${end}p" $f)
  # stop at closing brace of function heuristically: find first line that is "}"
  n=$(echo "$body" | grep -n "^}" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  [ -n "$n" ] && end=$((def+n))
  hasplain=$(sed -n "${def},${end}p" $f | grep -c 'spin_lock(&\|spin_lock((\|_spin_lock(&')
  hasbh=$(sed -n "${def},${end}p" $f | grep -c 'spin_lock_bh\|spin_lock_irqsave\|spin_lock_irq(')
  if [ "$hasplain" -gt 0 ]; then echo -e "$f\t$cb\t$def\t$end\tplain=$hasplain bh=$hasbh"; fi
done < $T/tasklet_cbs.tsv > $T/tasklet_plain_cb.txt; wc -l < $T/tasklet_plain_cb.txt; cat $T/tasklet_plain_cb.txt
